beforeSubmitPrompt.command: cmd /c "for /d %M in (\"%USERPROFILE%\.cursor\plugins\cache\*\") do @for /d %P in (\"%M\cursor-usage-collector\*\") do @if exist \"%P\scripts\report_usage.cmd\" (call \"%P\scripts\report_usage.cmd\" & exit /b 0) & if exist \"%USERPROFILE%\.cursor\plugins\local\cursor-usage-collector\scripts\report_usage.cmd\" (call \"%USERPROFILE%\.cursor\plugins\local\cursor-usage-collector\scripts\report_usage.cmd\" & exit /b 0) & echo {}" ; sh -c 'for f in ./scripts/report_usage.sh ../scripts/report_usage.sh "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/cursor-usage-collector/scripts/report_usage.sh"; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec sh "$f"; done; for f in "$HOME"/.cursor/plugins/cache/*/cursor-usage-collector/*/scripts/report_usage.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec sh "$f"; done; printf "%s\n" "{}"' ; exit 0
